content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a logic error in the condition that checks whether to pause the game when the escape key is pressed. The original condition only checked if the game was not loading a level (`!packetHandler.isLoadingLevel`), which prevented the pause menu from appearing if the game was in a loading state. The fix added an additional check to see if the game was not online (`!isOnline()`), allowing the pause menu to show up in singleplayer mode even when the game was loading a level.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a logic error in the condition that checks whether to pause the game when the escape key is pressed. The original condition only checked if the game was not loading a level (`!packetHandler.isLoadingLevel`), which prevented the pause menu from appearing if the game was in a loading state. The fix added an additional check to see if the game was not online (`!isOnline()`), allowing the pause menu to show up in singleplayer mode even when the game was loading a level.
Patch:
From 638ece305bdbd783e4c326011dd1446c737b536f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: 123DMWM <shmo1joe2@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2015 16:41:30 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] Another bug fix

Fixed a bug introduced in d37442c which was causing the menu to not show
up in singleplayer
---
 src/main/java/com/mojang/minecraft/Minecraft.java | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/main/java/com/mojang/minecraft/Minecraft.java b/src/main/java/com/mojang/minecraft/Minecraft.java
index 75edcf1..bd57e68 100644
--- a/src/main/java/com/mojang/minecraft/Minecraft.java
+++ b/src/main/java/com/mojang/minecraft/Minecraft.java
@@ -1926,7 +1926,7 @@ public final class Minecraft implements Runnable {
                     }
                     if (currentScreen == null) {
                         if (Keyboard.getEventKey() == Keyboard.KEY_ESCAPE) {
-                            if (!packetHandler.isLoadingLevel){
+                            if (!packetHandler.isLoadingLevel || !isOnline()){
                                 pause();
                             } else {
                                 Mouse.setGrabbed(false);
